story: Riordan Mansion State Historic Park is located in Flagstaff, Arizona, USA, and covers 5 acres of forest. It preserves a thirteen thousand square foot duplex mansion built in 1904 by lumber baron brothers Timothy and Michael Riordan.
matters: The park preserves the historic duplex home of lumber barons who played a role in the development of Flagstaff and northern Arizona.
name: Riordan Mansion State Historic Park
